profile.headline: Software Developer II at UWorld
profile.summary:
On a career/industry change journey from hospitality to software!

Aspiring Software Developer looking for a full stack development position. Tech skills include Java, React.js with Typescript, and SQL. Currently pursuing an Associates in Computer Science with an existing B.S.

👀 Check out my portfolio/resume on my website here -> https://michellephillips.me/

positions.title: Food And Beverage Supervisor
positions.description:
Opened the Hall Arts Hotel in December 2019, helped build team from ground up:
-Hired team of 30+ for hotel opening
-Training associates pre and post opening on brand standards, menus, beverage program, systems used
-Utilized UltiPro systems for schedule, labor, and payroll management
-InfoGenesis system usage for building floor plans and menus, running transactions and reports
-OpenTable for floor plans, reservation management, section management, and reports
-Participating in lead stand ups and facilitating department stand ups

positions.title: Assistant Outlets Manager
positions.description:
-Managing all food & beverage outlets utilizing micros systems
-Managing talent through forecasting and scheduling
-Supply and vendor management
-Period End Administration

positions.locationName: Dallas/Addison Marriott Quorum by the Galleria

positions.title: Restaurant Supervisor
positions.description:
-Main responsibilities included shift supervision and ensuring guest satisfaction
-Tracking sales and server tips using TEFRA tip reporting
-Guest Service Satisfaction monitoring, training and coordination of response
-Implemented a kanban agile project management system for changes relating to POS system
-Coordinated upgrade to new point of sale system
-Assisted with concept redevelopment for main hotel outlet including: beverage program, menu service training, menu design, POS implementation
-New hire processing, training, scheduling, and team building

positions.title: Front Desk
positions.description:
Administered MARSHA and PMS systems to create reservations, check availability, check in and out guests, edit reservations, make adjustments and corrections
Ensuring guest expectations were met both at registration and throughout their stay
Training, mentoring, and empowering new hires
Consistently leading Guest Service Satisfaction weekly scores at the Front Desk

positions.title: Front Desk
positions.description:
Excellent customer service including handling customer complaints and transactions
Directing customers as needed to various departments 
Cash Handling Experience
Made various reservations for guests, room blocks, and groups using OnQ Property Management

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description:
Assisted customers in their shopping needs including ordering products, adjusting prices to match sale ads, ringing up sales, filling out store credit card applications, and fulfilling returns and refunds
Stocked merchandise, checked inventory quantity, and adjusted store displays

positions.title: Service Supervisor
positions.description:
Assisted in managing the service operations team by opening and closing the store, adjusting employee schedules when needed, and ordering supplies for operations 
Balanced the store safe and cash registers daily to check for money shortages, including checks, Lotto, Moneygram, money orders, coupons, and cash
Assisted guests with issues and problems by providing superb customer service
Changed and adjusted prices throughout the store to match inventory and sale advertisements

organizations.name: Alpha Phi Omega- Gamma Rho Chapter
organizations.position: Secretary, Leadership Vice President, Webmaster Officer, Inter-Chapter Relations Officer, Conference Committee Chair, MBU Volunteer Coordinator · Aug 2012 - Dec 2015
organizations.description:
Volunteered 200+ hours with various community service organizations
APO LEADS certified.
